name: Odawara Touko
source:
A blonde twin-tail girl. Has an unclear background.
Play the muted trumpet, but remains noncommital.
Talk to [url=/c92284]Kei[/url] for some unknown reasons.
Simple and half-minded personality.
Inclined to do non-sensible stuff.
A spectacular boke showering others with questions without waiting for answers.
Special skills are mimicking chicken sound and pole vault.
Can single-handedly roleplay all characters in a historical drama.  
Loves [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E4%B8%89%E9%81%8A%E4%BA%AD%E5%9C%93%E6%AD%8C]San'yuutei Enka[/url] and [url=https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lucero_Tena]Lucero Thena[/url].

[Translated from the [url=http://wosakana.com/wosakana_soft/game/htv.html]offcial site[/url]]
